lines: d24: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Gilberto Niu is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d24: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d24: 🕯️ Gilberto Niu is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d24: What Gilberto kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d24: "Gilberto's gone." Thabo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Gilberto." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d24: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Joyce blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d24: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d24: 📖 LEARNED: Sewing & Textiles (Level 1). Mend tears so they hold: backstitch, small stitches, match the grain.
d24: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d24: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d24: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d24: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Gilberto Niu, 24 days. The mantle passes to Joyce Fisher.
d24: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Joyce Fisher, 41 — a tailor. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Lucky Rock.
d24: The village's quarrel was with Gilberto — and Gilberto is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d24: The fire knew Joyce before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
